title: Booking a Hotel Room
description: Four short recordings at hotels: a booking call, checking in, a voicemail and a welcome talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Booking a room
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Evans phone a hotel.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Good afternoon, Sunshine Hotel. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: Hello. I'd like to book a room, please.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Certainly. For how many people?

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: Two adults and one child.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: And for how many nights?

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: Three nights, from the twelfth of June.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: One moment. Yes, we have a family room. It has two beds and a sofa. It's ninety pounds a night.

script.speaker: Mr Evans
script.text: Is breakfast included?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, breakfast is from seven to ten o'clock.

parts.title: Part 2 · Checking in
parts.intro: You will hear Mrs Taylor arrive at the hotel.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Welcome to the Sunshine Hotel. Do you have a booking?

script.speaker: Mrs Taylor
script.text: Yes, the name is Taylor. I booked a double room for two nights.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, I see it. You're in room two hundred and five, on the second floor.

script.speaker: Mrs Taylor
script.text: Is there a lift?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, it's next to the restaurant. Here's your key card.

script.speaker: Mrs Taylor
script.text: What time is check-out?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: At eleven o'clock. And the pool is open until nine in the evening.

script.speaker: Mrs Taylor
script.text: Lovely. Is there internet in the room?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, the internet is free. The password is on the card.

parts.title: Part 3 · A voicemail
parts.intro: You will hear a message from a hotel manager.

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: Hello, this is Mr Dang from the Lakeview Hotel, calling for Mrs Lan.

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: I'm sorry, but there is a problem with your booking for the twentieth of August. The sea-view room is not available because of a broken window.

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: We can give you a garden-view room, and it's cheaper. It's sixty pounds, not eighty pounds. Is that OK?

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: Also, the hotel bus can pick you up at the airport. It leaves at half past two.

script.speaker: Mr Dang
script.text: Please call me back before Friday on the number on our website. Thank you.

parts.title: Part 4 · A welcome talk
parts.intro: You will hear a hotel worker, Anna, welcoming guests.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Welcome, everyone, to the Mountain View Hotel. I'm Anna from the front desk. Here is some useful information.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Breakfast is in the restaurant on the ground floor, from half past six to ten o'clock. Lunch is not included.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: The swimming pool is on the roof. It's closed on Mondays because we clean it.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: If you want a taxi, ask at the desk. A taxi to the town centre costs about eight pounds.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Finally, please put your towels on the floor if you want new ones. Thank you, and enjoy your stay!
